about_the_game:
Blind Spot is a multiplayer co-op, survival horror game. You play as a Ghoul Expert and your goal is to protect a family from Ghouls invading their residential home. Use cameras to surveil the perimeter around the house from a safe distance and use the tools provided to set up a defense. Ghouls are being lured to the house in order to fulfill an unholy ritual with the blood of this innocent family. You must stop the Ghouls from killing all the family members until first light.

Family Matters:

With the cameras you will be able to see the family chill maxing in there domicile (usually sleeping). But with all the commotion of the Ghoul Experts doing their "jobs" the family will wake and dynamically move around their house possibly putting themselves in harms way.

Tricky Ghouls:

As a premier Ghoul Expert, you have many tricks and tools to help you overcome the Ghouls. But the Ghouls are fearsome foes and they understand you weaknesses. The Ghouls will sabotage the power grid, separate you from your friends, break into your safe room and trick you in ways you could not believe.

One Night With Frendies:

In order to win the game you must survive the whole night! Each new hour of the night will be more difficult than the previous hour and will introduce new challenges and enemies.

Team Work:

There is a lot of work to be done and it is recommended to play online in a squad. There are many tasks you'll need to accomplish and you'll be able to split the load between your group. You can also choose to play with nobody and the game will intelligently even the scales of difficulty to match.

Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4430
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 760 or AMD R9 270X
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX®-compatible
  • Additional Notes: Internet connection

short_description: Multiplayer co-op, survival horror game. Play with your friends as you monitor and secure a residential house that is being invaded by Ghouls. Use cameras to surveil the property and keep the family inside safe. Watch your back and try to survive!
